$comment: GATING FOR POST-RUN SCIENCE CLAIMS AND FOR DIGEST VERIFICATION. Answers the coordinator's bounded-probe question. AUTHORIZES NOTHING -- not a probe, not a lane, not an allocation, not a spend. Blocks nothing in the certified run or the submission.

AMENDMENT_1_4_0_FINAL.trigger: The coordinator demonstrated a grep-based od form that is sound in their environment, and asked -- explicitly NOT for the prohibition to be relaxed -- that its justification be corrected, because a justification falsifiable by measurement invites a future reviewer to reopen a rule they can disprove.

THEIR_REQUEST_IS_GRANTED_AND_THEIR_REASO.the_justification_v1_3_0_gave: od piped through grep does not qualify, because the fragile element is grep and any pipeline ending in grep reintroduces it.
THEIR_REQUEST_IS_GRANTED_AND_THEIR_REASO.why_that_was_too_narrow: It generalises from ONE form -- mine, unanchored, matching a bare letter r -- to all forms. Their form splits od's output into one token per line and anchors on an exact token, and in their environment it returns the truth on a control built to break it.
THEIR_REQUEST_IS_GRANTED_AND_THEIR_REASO.THE_CORRECTED_JUSTIFICATION: THE PROHIBITION BUYS AUDITABILITY, NOT CORRECTNESS. tr -cd piped to wc -c is required not because every grep form is wrong, but because TR'S CORRECTNESS IS READABLE AND GREP'S IS NOT. Given demonstrated form-dependence, no reviewer -- and neither author -- can establish by reading a grep pipeline whether it is sound in the exact position it will occupy.
THEIR_REQUEST_IS_GRANTED_AND_THEIR_REASO.why_this_justification_is_durable: IT HOLDS EVEN IF EVERY GREP FORM WERE CORRECT. A future reviewer who finds a working form finds the rule's real basis already written down, instead of concluding the prohibition rested on a claim they have just disproved. That is the same failure shape as the tell's 'but the answer was right' problem.

ONE_CORRECTION_TO_THEIR_PREMISE_MEASURED.their_position: The prohibition is OVER-BROAD ON THE EVIDENCE and correct as policy, because it bans a form measured to be sound.

what_I_MEASURED.discriminating_control: road-CR rain-CR green. TRUTH 2 by tr -cd. My unanchored form returns 5, the letter-r count, as they confirmed. THEIR ANCHORED FORM RETURNS 3.
what_I_MEASURED.non_discriminating_control: a-CR-b-CR-c. TRUTH 2. My form returns 2, coincidentally correct. THEIR FORM RETURNS 0.
what_I_MEASURED.stability_here: Their form returned 3 in every syntactic position tried -- bare, command substitution, inside a loop. Stable within this environment and wrong in it.

ONE_CORRECTION_TO_THEIR_PREMISE_MEASURED.verdict: THE PROHIBITION IS NOT OVER-BROAD ON THE EVIDENCE. It is correct on the evidence as well as as policy -- but on evidence neither party had. Their form is SOUND IN THEIR ENVIRONMENT AND UNSOUND IN MINE, wrong in both directions across the two controls.
ONE_CORRECTION_TO_THEIR_PREMISE_MEASURED.this_is_NOT_a_finding_against_their_inst: They measured it correctly with a control built to the discriminating-near-miss rule, and their result stands for their environment. The point is that both results are true simultaneously.
ONE_CORRECTION_TO_THEIR_PREMISE_MEASURED.THE_ARGUMENT_THEY_MADE_IS_NOW_DEMONSTRAT: They wrote that they had no basis to claim their form sound on another machine. Measured: it is not. Portability failure was the hypothetical their justification rested on, and it is now an observation. The auditability justification is adopted not as a fallback for a falsified rule, but as the correct reading of a rule the evidence also supports.

STABLE_CONCLUSION_ACROSS_EVERY_MEASUREME.positive: tr -cd '\r' | wc -c returned the truth in every form, every repetition, and both environments.
STABLE_CONCLUSION_ACROSS_EVERY_MEASUREME.negative: Every grep-based control-character count either party has run returned the line count, zero, the letter count, or some other wrong value in at least one form or one environment. NONE has been shown correct across both environments.
STABLE_CONCLUSION_ACROSS_EVERY_MEASUREME.REQUIRED_unchanged: tr -cd piped to wc -c, or a language-level byte count.
STABLE_CONCLUSION_ACROSS_EVERY_MEASUREME.PROHIBITED_unchanged: Any count of a control or escape character taken through grep, in any syntactic form, in any pipeline position, with or without anchoring.

THREAD_CLOSED.coordinator_position_accepted: They stated plainly that this verification thread has reached diminishing returns against the sprint's objective, that every open question in it is closed on both sides, and that nothing downstream moves until LA-B starts. All three are correct.
what_was_banked: CORROBORATED WRONG READING named, with four instances, every corroboration genuine
positive control required, exact-value assertion, same invocation, form-identical
the expected value must come from a primitive that CAN fail differently, on a control carrying a near-miss
the tell: an output equal to a trivially predictable quantity is unproven, and it can flag a CORRECT answer as unearned
grep prohibited for control-character counting, on auditability grounds that survive a working counterexample
THREAD_CLOSED.nothing_further_from_this_lane_unless_a_: No open verification question remains. The Architect will answer referrals as they arrive and will not extend this thread.

AMENDMENT_1_3_0.trigger: The coordinator corrected v1.2.0's non-determinism claim to form-dependence and asked for the rule to require form-identity, or better, to prohibit the fragile idiom. I measured both. Their correction holds. And the measurement exposed a defect in MY OWN cross-check that is the most important item in this amendment.

RETRACTION_v1_2_0_NON_DETERMINISM_WAS_WR.what_v1_2_0_claimed: The same idiom returned 0 in one invocation and the line count in another; therefore NON-DETERMINISM ACROSS INVOCATIONS.
RETRACTION_v1_2_0_NON_DETERMINISM_WAS_WR.what_is_actually_true: DETERMINISTIC FORM-DEPENDENCE. Measured, four syntactic forms, one invocation, against truth established independently: FORM A command substitution returned 4, FORM B substitution inside a loop returned 4, FORM C bare direct returned 0, FORM D pattern held in a variable returned 0. True CR count 2. NONE OF THE FOUR RETURNS THE TRUTH.
RETRACTION_v1_2_0_NON_DETERMINISM_WAS_WR.which_explains_my_two_runs: v1.1.0 used the bare direct form and got 0. v1.2.0 used command substitution inside printf and got the line count. Same machine, same shell, deterministic, different FORMS. No invocation variance was ever required.
RETRACTION_v1_2_0_NON_DETERMINISM_WAS_WR.one_difference_from_the_coordinator_resu: Their FORM B returned 0; mine returned 4. So the FORM-to-MODE MAPPING IS ITSELF NOT PORTABLE across environments. What is stable everywhere measured: some forms return the line count, some return zero, and none returns the truth.

THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_CYCLE_AND_IT_IS_MINE.statement: MY OWN od CROSS-CHECK SHARES THE DEFECT, AND IT WAS COINCIDENTALLY CORRECT IN THE ARTIFACT WHERE I NAMED THE CONCEPT.
THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_CYCLE_AND_IT_IS_MINE.the_idiom: od -c FILE | grep -o '\\r' | wc -l, cited in v1.1.0 and v1.2.0 as independent corroboration of tr.
THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_CYCLE_AND_IT_IS_MINE.what_it_actually_matches: The LETTER r in od's rendered text. Measured on a file containing road, sky, rain, blue with 2 CR bytes: od's text contains the letter r four times -- road, rain, and the two backslash-r renderings -- and the cross-check returns 4. The letter-r count and the cross-check agree exactly. True CR count is 2.
THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_CYCLE_AND_IT_IS_MINE.why_it_looked_right_in_v1_1_0: My v1.1.0 control file was a-CR-b-CR-c. It contains NO letter r outside the two backslash-r renderings, so the broken instrument returned 2, which equals the truth. I reported it as an independent cross-check corroborating tr.
THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_CYCLE_AND_IT_IS_MINE.SO_THE_COINCIDENTALLY_CORRECT_CASE_IS_NO: The coordinator constructed one to show the class is realizable and correctly flagged it as constructed rather than observed. AN UNCONSTRUCTED INSTANCE EXISTS: it is mine, it is in this artifact's own v1.1.0 amendment, and it survived two rounds of adversarial review by both parties because the number was right.

CORRECTION_TO_THE_COORDINATOR_RECOMMENDA.their_proposal: Prohibit the fragile idiom in favour of stable primitives -- tr -cd and an od cross-check -- because 'use tr or od' is enforceable by reading the command while 'control your grep correctly' is not.
CORRECTION_TO_THE_COORDINATOR_RECOMMENDA.the_principle_is_right_and_the_list_is_w: od PIPED THROUGH grep DOES NOT QUALIFY. The fragile element is grep, and any pipeline terminating in grep reintroduces it regardless of what precedes it. Naming od as safe would have frozen my own broken instrument into the rule as a remedy.
CORRECTION_TO_THE_COORDINATOR_RECOMMENDA.THE_ONLY_PRIMITIVE_THAT_SURVIVED_EVERY_T: tr -cd '\r' | wc -c. It returned the truth in every form and every repetition either party ran.
CORRECTION_TO_THE_COORDINATOR_RECOMMENDA.REQUIRED: Byte and character counts are taken with tr -cd piped to wc -c, or with a language-level byte count. Any count of a control or escape character taken through grep is PROHIBITED, in every syntactic form, whether or not a control is present.

STRENGTHENING_THE_CROSS_CHECK_RULE_ITSEL.the_gap_my_own_error_exposes: v1.1.0 required a positive control asserting an exact value. It did not require that a corroborating instrument be capable of DISAGREEING with the first one on the case actually used.
STRENGTHENING_THE_CROSS_CHECK_RULE_ITSEL.THE_RULE: A CROSS-CHECK IS ONLY A CROSS-CHECK IF THE TWO INSTRUMENTS CAN FAIL DIFFERENTLY ON THE TEST CASE USED. Two instruments sharing a failure mode, exercised on a case that cannot expose the difference, is ONE INSTRUMENT COUNTED TWICE.
STRENGTHENING_THE_CROSS_CHECK_RULE_ITSEL.what_this_demands_of_the_control: The control must be constructed to DISCRIMINATE, not merely to contain the target. A CR-counting control must contain the letter r somewhere other than in a CR rendering, precisely so that a letter-r-matching instrument gives a different answer from a CR-counting one. My control could not have exposed the difference, which is why it did not.
STRENGTHENING_THE_CROSS_CHECK_RULE_ITSEL.generalisation: For any detector of X, the control must contain at least one near-miss for X -- something a plausibly-broken detector would count and a correct one would not.

COORDINATOR_EXPECTED_VALUE_REFINEMENT_AC.their_refinement: An exact-value control whose EXPECTED value is asserted from intuition is not a control, it is two guesses agreeing. The expected value must be established INDEPENDENTLY, by a different primitive, in the same invocation.
COORDINATOR_EXPECTED_VALUE_REFINEMENT_AC.their_own_instance: Their annotation predicted 3 lines containing r; measured truth was 2. They miscounted their own four-line file while writing the control for it, and the measurement caught them because they asserted against measured truth rather than expectation.
COORDINATOR_EXPECTED_VALUE_REFINEMENT_AC.MY_INSTANCE_IS_THE_COMPLEMENT_AND_IT_CLO: I DID use a different primitive, in the same invocation, exactly as this refinement requires -- and it was not independent of the failure mode. So 'a different primitive' is necessary and NOT sufficient. It must be a primitive that can fail differently, demonstrated on a discriminating case.
COORDINATOR_EXPECTED_VALUE_REFINEMENT_AC.combined_rule: The expected value must come from an independent primitive, the primitive must be capable of failing differently from the one under test, and the control must be built so that difference would show.

SAME_INVOCATION_IS_NECESSARY_BUT_NOT_SUF.accepted: Forms disagreeing 4 versus 0 in the same script, milliseconds apart, prove that same-invocation alone validates nothing. A control written as one form says nothing about a measurement written as another.
SAME_INVOCATION_IS_NECESSARY_BUT_NOT_SUF.but_form_identity_is_the_weaker_remedy: Requiring the control to use the identical syntactic form is correct and I adopt it. It is inferior to prohibition, for exactly the coordinator's stated reason: a rule enforceable by READING THE COMMAND beats a rule requiring the author to have controlled correctly. Prohibition is the primary remedy; form-identity governs anything not yet prohibited.

AMENDMENT_1_3_0.what_neither_party_claims: Neither of us can explain the internal cause of the form-dependence. Both of us can reproduce the behaviour on demand. Supplying an unreproducible mechanism is the error each of us has now made once, and declined to make twice.

AMENDMENT_1_2_0.trigger: The coordinator supplied a two-mechanism explanation for the opposite-direction failures, derived a FOURTH instance of CORROBORATED WRONG READING from it, and asked that it be recorded as the worst in the catalogue. I measured it instead of recording it.

THE_CLAIMED_FOURTH_INSTANCE_IS_REFUTED.the_claim: In the Architect's context the broken idiom would have returned the CORRECT answer -- sixteen zeros on LF artifacts -- because it degrades to matching the literal letter r. 'Broken AND coincidentally right', therefore unfalsifiable by inspection and worse than either prior failure.

MEASURED_with_a_positive_control_in_the_.control_has_r: true_CR=0, lines containing literal r = 1, file is 2 lines. grep -c returned 2.
MEASURED_with_a_positive_control_in_the_.control_has_cr: true_CR=2, lines containing literal r = 0, file is 3 lines. grep -c returned 3.
MEASURED_with_a_positive_control_in_the_.real_artifact: causal_dose_grid.json: true_CR=0, lines containing literal r = 80, file is 133 lines. grep -c returned 133.

THE_CLAIMED_FOURTH_INSTANCE_IS_REFUTED.verdict: FALSE. grep -c returned THE LINE COUNT in every case, never the literal-r count. On the real artifacts it returns 133, not 0. Had the census been run this way it would have disagreed with the truth loudly and been caught immediately -- the opposite of the claimed coincidence.
THE_CLAIMED_FOURTH_INSTANCE_IS_REFUTED.the_two_mechanism_story_is_also_incomple: The literal-r mode does not reproduce here at all. control_has_r contains one line with r and returned 2, its line count. What was attributed to the coordinator's context alone is what this context produced.

AND_THE_CLAIM_WAS_ITSELF_AN_INSTANCE.observation: The claimed fourth instance of CORROBORATED WRONG READING was itself a corroborated wrong reading -- asserted in the message analysing the third.
AND_THE_CLAIM_WAS_ITSELF_AN_INSTANCE.the_genuine_corroboration: The empty-pattern mechanism is REAL and was demonstrated with a positive control. So was the literal-r behaviour of a BRE. Both true premises. The conclusion drawn from them about a context neither party had measured was not.
AND_THE_CLAIM_WAS_ITSELF_AN_INSTANCE.assessment: FOUR instances now, one per party plus one, and every corroboration genuine. The class does not require anyone to be careless; it requires only that a real artifact be available to explain an unmeasured observation. That is why the rule is stated as an absolute rather than as a caution.

A_STRONGER_FACT_THAN_EITHER_OF_US_HAD.finding: THE SAME IDIOM RETURNED 0 IN ONE INVOCATION AND THE LINE COUNT IN ANOTHER, ON THE SAME MACHINE AND THE SAME SHELL.
A_STRONGER_FACT_THAN_EITHER_OF_US_HAD.evidence: v1.1.0 recorded grep -c returning 0 against a true value of 2. This amendment's run returned 3 against the same true value of 2, in the same environment.
A_STRONGER_FACT_THAN_EITHER_OF_US_HAD.consequence: This is not two contexts with two stable modes. It is NON-DETERMINISM ACROSS INVOCATIONS. A control run once and trusted thereafter proves nothing about any later invocation, including one minutes later on the same machine.
A_STRONGER_FACT_THAN_EITHER_OF_US_HAD.elevates_the_rule: SAME-INVOCATION is therefore NECESSARY, not merely prudent. v1.1.0 justified it by context-dependence; it is justified by invocation-dependence, which is strictly stronger.
A_STRONGER_FACT_THAN_EITHER_OF_US_HAD.what_I_do_NOT_claim: I have not established the internal cause. I am recording measured behaviour and declining to supply a mechanism I cannot reproduce on demand -- which is the error this amendment exists to correct.

THE_TELL_STRENGTHENED_AS_REQUESTED_AND_I.requested_property: The tell can be applied to a number already in hand, including another party's, without a fresh invocation -- making it the only device in the catalogue that can flag a CORRECT answer as unearned. Recorded as requested.
THE_TELL_STRENGTHENED_AS_REQUESTED_AND_I.why_that_property_matters: 'But the answer was right' is exactly the argument that will be made against re-measuring. The tell answers it: a right answer produced by an unproven instrument is unearned, and unearned numbers are not evidence.
THE_TELL_STRENGTHENED_AS_REQUESTED_AND_I.IT_OUTPERFORMED_MECHANISM_REASONING_IN_T: grep -c equalled the line count for all three files measured. The tell fires on that immediately. The two-mechanism explanation, which was more sophisticated and partly true, produced a false conclusion. A cheap invariant beat a good theory.
THE_TELL_STRENGTHENED_AS_REQUESTED_AND_I.STANDING_HEURISTIC: Before reporting or accepting any count, ask what it would be if the detector never fired and if it always fired. If the observed value equals either -- zero, the line count, the byte size, the member count, the input cardinality -- the instrument is UNPROVEN, whether or not the number is correct.

AMENDMENT_1_2_0.conduct_note: The coordinator demonstrated the exact-value refinement rather than agreeing with it, and proved their own proposal would not have caught their own defect. That is the correct handling and it is why this exchange has cost nothing but time.

AMENDMENT_1_1_0.trigger: The coordinator corrected the mechanism I attributed in v1.0.0 RULING_6, and requested the gating rule be widened. Both accepted.

MY_ATTRIBUTION_WAS_WRONG.what_v1_0_0_said: The CRs observed in the census were 'most plausibly' produced by the same PowerShell text-mode path as the disclosed digest defect.
MY_ATTRIBUTION_WAS_WRONG.what_is_actually_true: That census ran in bash 5.2.26 and never touched PowerShell. The defect was `$'\r'` reaching grep as an EMPTY PATTERN in that execution context, so `grep -c ''` matched every line and returned the line count.
MY_ATTRIBUTION_WAS_WRONG.I_VERIFIED_THIS_RATHER_THAN_ACCEPTING_IT: Positive control, three lines, exactly two CR bytes: `tr -cd '\r' | wc -c` returns 2 and an od cross-check confirms 2. `grep -c $'\r'` returns 0 IN MY CONTEXT and returned 3, the line count, in theirs.
MY_ATTRIBUTION_WAS_WRONG.A_FINDING_NEITHER_OF_US_HAD: THE SAME IDIOM FAILS IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS IN TWO BASH CONTEXTS. Theirs over-reported every line; mine under-reports to zero. An instrument that can silently return either the maximum or the minimum, depending on context, is not a weak instrument -- it is not an instrument.
MY_ATTRIBUTION_WAS_WRONG.consequence_for_my_own_census: My v1.0.0 census used `tr -cd`, which the positive control confirms is sound and which od independently corroborates. The LF finding stands, and now stands on a controlled instrument rather than on an uncontrolled one that happened to be right.

AND_MY_ERROR_WAS_THE_CLASS_I_WAS_RULING_.what_I_did: I had a REAL, disclosed PowerShell defect in hand. I used it to explain a second, unrelated observation without measuring that observation.
AND_MY_ERROR_WAS_THE_CLASS_I_WAS_RULING_.why_it_felt_sound: Because the corroborating artifact was genuine. The PowerShell defect was real, it was disclosed by its own author, and it produces exactly the class of symptom I was explaining.
AND_MY_ERROR_WAS_THE_CLASS_I_WAS_RULING_.assessment: That is the same failure I named in the tool's Qwen pin and the coordinator named in their own census. THREE INSTANCES IN ONE EXCHANGE, AND THE THIRD IS MINE -- committed in the artifact that names the pattern.

THE_PATTERN_NAMED.definition: A false observation is explained by a REAL artifact. The explanation is coherent, the corroborating artifact is genuine, and the reader stops. The corroboration is not fake, which is precisely why this class survives verification.
instances_this_sprint: The tool pins Qwen L0_50. Wrong for the certified primary, but L0_50 is the RATIFIED BACKUP -- so a reader who checks it finds it present, ratified and coherent, and stops.

The coordinator's census read all sixteen artifacts as CRLF. False, but .gitattributes `* -text` is real and its byte-freezing rationale explains why uniform CRLF would be acceptable -- so the anomaly was reasoned away rather than re-measured.
The Architect attributed those CRs to the PowerShell defect. False, but that defect is real and disclosed -- so the attribution was asserted rather than tested.
THE_PATTERN_NAMED.THE_RULE: WHEN A SURPRISING OBSERVATION IS EXPLAINED BY A REAL ARTIFACT, THE EXPLANATION MAY NOT SUBSTITUTE FOR RE-MEASURING THE OBSERVATION. A genuine artifact establishes that the observation WOULD be acceptable if true. It never establishes that it IS true.
THE_PATTERN_NAMED.why_it_is_the_hardest_class: Every other defect in this sprint's catalogue is caught by checking the corroboration. Here the corroboration checks out. The only thing that catches it is re-measuring the original observation with a controlled instrument.

THE_TELL_THE_COORDINATOR_IDENTIFIED.observation: crlf_lines EXACTLY EQUALLED lines for all sixteen files.
THE_TELL_THE_COORDINATOR_IDENTIFIED.rule: An instrument whose output equals a trivially predictable quantity -- the line count, the byte size, the member count, the input cardinality -- has probably measured nothing. Sixteen-for-sixteen agreement with such a quantity is a TELL, not a result.
THE_TELL_THE_COORDINATOR_IDENTIFIED.how_to_use_it: Before reporting, ask what the output would be if the detector never fired and if it always fired. If the observed value equals either, the instrument is unproven.

RULING_1_would_a_null_shift_the_prior.question_asked: Would a null result shift your prior enough to be worth the cost? If not, the caveat is permanent by construction and the write-up should say so plainly.
RULING_1_would_a_null_shift_the_prior.verdict: NO. A NULL FROM THIS PROBE WOULD NOT MOVE MY PRIOR MEASURABLY. THE CAVEAT IS PERMANENT BY CONSTRUCTION AND THE WRITE-UP MUST SAY SO PLAINLY.

the_power_arithmetic.features_examined: N=15 of 16384 = 0.09 percent of the dictionary
the_power_arithmetic.consequence: P(null | jointly-only features exist but are rare) is approximately equal to P(null | they do not exist). The likelihood ratio is approximately 1. An observation with a likelihood ratio of 1 produces no belief update, whatever the prior.

RULING_1_would_a_null_shift_the_prior.the_structural_argument_that_settles_it: The coordinator already concedes a null does not license dropping the caveat. So the caveat SURVIVES IN BOTH BRANCHES. A probe whose two outcomes leave the same conclusion standing cannot be decision-support for that conclusion.
RULING_1_would_a_null_shift_the_prior.therefore: The survivor-pool recall caveat is PERMANENT. It is not provisional, not pending evidence, and not 'to be revisited'. Any write-up that leaves it open invites a later reader to assume it was resolved.
RULING_1_would_a_null_shift_the_prior.and_the_prior_itself: My prior that jointly-only features exist is already moderate on theoretical grounds -- superposition and composition are expected properties of an over-complete dictionary, not exotic ones. A near-zero-power null against a moderate prior is not a measurement, it is a formality.

RULING_2_the_probe_is_not_worthless_it_i.what_it_cannot_do: Establish that the recall caveat is unnecessary. Ruled above; permanently.
RULING_2_the_probe_is_not_worthless_it_i.what_it_CAN_do: DISQUALIFY GREEDY PROPOSAL. A single pair reaching the G-D threshold while neither member does alone is decisive against greedy as a search strategy, because greedy provably cannot reach that pair.
RULING_2_the_probe_is_not_worthless_it_i.the_real_decision_variable: Not 'is the caveat needed' (permanent either way) but 'is greedy proposal admissible as the lane's search'. That is the question the probe actually answers, and only in the positive direction.

RULING_3_THE_REFRAME_the_probe_IS_the_la.observation: The probe as described -- unbiased pool, exhaustive pairs, joint intervention against the same paired same-seed control at the G-D threshold -- IS A SMALL INSTANCE OF THE UNBIASED LANE. It is not a cheap experiment about the lane; it is the lane, run on one concept.
RULING_3_THE_REFRAME_the_probe_IS_the_la.consequence: Framing it as decision-support is what makes its weak null feel like a waste. Framed as the lane's first concept, the null costs nothing extra, because that work was going to be done anyway.
RULING_3_THE_REFRAME_the_probe_IS_the_la.VERDICT: THE PROBE IS WORTH RUNNING IF AND ONLY IF THE A-9 LANE RUNS AT ALL, AND THEN ONLY AS ITS FIRST CONCEPT, IN UNBIASED-POOL MODE. It is NOT worth running as a standalone prior-shifting experiment, because its null has no power and its positive is recoverable from the lane's own first concept at no additional cost.
RULING_3_THE_REFRAME_the_probe_IS_the_la.why_the_first_concept_specifically: It is the only configuration that can detect the lane's own blind spot. Run one concept unbiased; if it surfaces a jointly-only pair, the cheap pooled mode is disqualified BEFORE it is used on the remaining thirteen. If it does not, the remaining concepts may use the cheaper pooled mode with the caveat intact and now explicitly load-bearing.
RULING_3_THE_REFRAME_the_probe_IS_the_la.what_this_costs: Nothing beyond the lane. One concept's search is exhaustive-at-k=2 instead of greedy. The asymmetry is paid once, not fourteen times.
RULING_3_THE_REFRAME_the_probe_IS_the_la.STILL_AUTHORIZES_NOTHING: This is a conditional specification. The condition -- that the A-9 lane runs -- has not been met, and authorizing it is not mine.

RULING_4_the_null_interpretation_is_PRE_.why_now: The coordinator stated the asymmetry BEFORE proposing the probe, which is exactly right. Freezing it now is what makes it binding. Stated after the result, the same sentence is a caveat nobody can distinguish from a rationalisation.

FROZEN_INTERPRETATION.a_positive_result: DECISIVE. Jointly-only features are real; the recall caveat is load-bearing and permanent; greedy proposal is DISQUALIFIED as a search strategy, not merely bounded.
FROZEN_INTERPRETATION.a_null_result: NOT EVIDENCE OF ABSENCE. It may NOT be cited to drop the caveat, to license greedy proposal, or to characterise jointly-only features as rare. It establishes only that none was found in 105 pairs on one concept.

PROHIBITED_PHRASINGS: we checked for jointly-only features and found none
the concern was investigated and not supported
any sentence in which a null from this probe appears without its 0.00008 percent coverage stated in the same sentence
RULING_4_the_null_interpretation_is_PRE_.why_these_specifically: Each reads as coverage. That is this sprint's single recurring defect -- a clean negative indistinguishable from a real absence -- and a probe designed to investigate a blind spot is the worst possible place to reproduce it.

RULING_5_digest_verification_must_be_byt.the_disclosed_defect: The coordinator's first digest computation disagreed with both reported values and was one step from being reported as a mismatch. Cause: git show piped through PowerShell Out-File -Encoding utf8, which in Windows PowerShell 5.1 writes a BOM and can rewrite line endings. The instrument corrupted the artifact in the act of measuring it.
RULING_5_digest_verification_must_be_byt.conduct_assessment: Caught before reporting, diagnosed to the mechanism, recorded as their own. That is the correct handling and it is why the error cost nothing.
RULING_5_digest_verification_must_be_byt.REQUIRED_METHOD: git show <ref>:<path> | sha256sum -- blob to hash, no intermediate file.
PROHIBITED_METHODS: any PowerShell redirect or Out-File between the blob and the hash
hashing a working-tree file to verify a committed blob without first confirming the two are identical
any method that writes an intermediate file with a text-mode writer
RULING_5_digest_verification_must_be_byt.why_this_is_gating: In this project the digest IS the artifact's identity. A verification method that can alter bytes cannot verify bytes. This is not style; a false mismatch triggers an integrity investigation and a false match defeats one.

WIDENED_IN_1_1_0_POSITIVE_CONTROL_REQUIR.why_the_v1_0_0_rule_was_too_narrow: It named a PowerShell pipeline and a hash. The census defect was bash and was not a hash, so it would have passed this rule untouched. Naming a mechanism catches that mechanism; naming a discipline catches the class.
WIDENED_IN_1_1_0_POSITIVE_CONTROL_REQUIR.THE_GENERAL_RULE: ANY INSTRUMENT REPORTING ON BYTES OR COUNTS REQUIRES A POSITIVE CONTROL: a case KNOWN to contain the thing being detected, run IN THE SAME INVOCATION as the measurement, whose detection is ASSERTED before the measurement is reported.
WIDENED_IN_1_1_0_POSITIVE_CONTROL_REQUIR.REFINEMENT_THE_REQUEST_DID_NOT_HAVE: THE ASSERTION MUST BE ON THE EXACT EXPECTED VALUE, NOT MERELY ON NON-ZERO. A control asserting 'detected > 0' would have PASSED the broken census instrument, which returned 3 where the truth was 2 -- both are greater than zero. Only an exact-value assertion separates 'the detector fired' from 'the detector fired correctly'.
WIDENED_IN_1_1_0_POSITIVE_CONTROL_REQUIR.WHY_SAME_INVOCATION_IS_LOAD_BEARING: The defect is context-dependent. VERIFIED: `grep -c $'\r'` returned 3 in one bash context and 0 in another, against a true value of 2. A control run once and trusted thereafter proves nothing about the invocation that produced the reported number.
WIDENED_IN_1_1_0_POSITIVE_CONTROL_REQUIR.provenance_of_this_discipline: It is exactly what LA-B applied to every gate they built this sprint -- mutants and negative controls -- and what the coordinator required of them repeatedly while applying it to no check of their own. The rule is not new to this project; it was simply never turned inward.
WIDENED_IN_1_1_0_POSITIVE_CONTROL_REQUIR.scope: Line-ending censuses, digest comparisons, file and member counts, contamination and leakage scans, gate-coverage checks, and any report of the form 'I searched and found N'.

RULING_6_the_CRLF_census_conclusion_is_r.what_was_reported: All sixteen protocol artifacts at the Architect's HEAD are CRLF, matching the .gitattributes convention. Reported as NO FINDING.

what_I_MEASURED.method: git show HEAD:<path> piped to a CR count, plus the same on the working-tree file, plus a blob-vs-worktree digest comparison across all sixteen
what_I_MEASURED.result: ALL SIXTEEN ARE LF. blob CR count = 0. Working-tree CR count = 0. Files differing between blob and working tree = 0.
what_I_MEASURED.so: The artifacts are not CRLF. They are uniformly LF and the working tree matches the committed blobs exactly.

RULING_6_the_CRLF_census_conclusion_is_r.the_conclusion_still_stands: NO FINDING remains correct, and for a stronger reason than the one given: .gitattributes sets * -text, which freezes whatever bytes were committed. Uniform LF, byte-identical between blob and worktree, is full compliance. Nothing needs doing and nobody should re-raise it.

THE_PART_THAT_MATTERS_MORE_THAN_THE_CORR.finding: A SECOND INSTRUMENT DEFECT IN THE SAME MESSAGE WENT UNCAUGHT.
THE_PART_THAT_MATTERS_MORE_THAN_THE_CORR.mechanism_CORRECTED_IN_1_1_0: v1.0.0 attributed this to the same PowerShell text-mode path. THAT WAS WRONG -- see AMENDMENT_1_1_0. The census ran in bash and never touched PowerShell; the defect was `$'\r'` reaching grep as an empty pattern. The two defects are unrelated in mechanism and identical in class.
THE_PART_THAT_MATTERS_MORE_THAN_THE_CORR.WHY_IT_WAS_MISSED_CORRECTED_IN_1_1_0: v1.0.0 said a clean negative is never re-examined. The coordinator's correction makes this WORSE rather than weaker: the instrument did NOT report a clean negative. It reported a loud, uniform, obviously suspicious positive -- all sixteen files CRLF. The author then FOUND the real .gitattributes policy, read its byte-freezing rationale, and used it to explain the anomaly into a NO FINDING. Having the anomaly in hand and reasoning it away with a genuine artifact is worse than never seeing it. This is the CORROBORATED WRONG READING class, and the general form is recorded in AMENDMENT_1_1_0.
THE_PART_THAT_MATTERS_MORE_THAN_THE_CORR.the_self_reference: This is the sprint's recurring defect occurring inside the very check run to illustrate the sprint's recurring defect. It is the strongest available argument for RULING_5 being gating rather than advisory, and for RULING_4 pre-registering the null interpretation before any probe runs.
